breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains W2=100 m/s and beta2=30° while asserting Va=106.1 m/s. These three values are mutually inconsistent (100*cos(30°)≈86.6≠106.1). The ground truth resolves this by recalculating W2=Va/cos(beta2)≈122.5 m/s. The agent did not correct W2 or beta2, so the contradiction persists.
